name: shopify-inventory-report-and-stockout-forecast
description: Use for "what's about to run out", "what should I reorder", "when do I need to place the order", "how much stock do I have", "what's my inventory worth", "which SKUs are overstocked", "how much cash is sitting in dead stock", or "what's my sell-through" — even when the user never says "inventory". Use when the decision is what to order and by when, or whether a sales fall is a stock problem rather than a demand problem. Shopify only.
